snippet.title: Let's Sing Trailer [Europe] - English
snippet.description: Let's Sing for Wii is a karaoke game for up to four players. Alone, in a team or in a competitive mode, players can perform 40 tracks from famous artists, including the original music videos. Bring your friends together, warm up for your performance and join in the fun!
